_about: After-the-fact reporting: damage, casualties, photos of last night. Applied ONLY to channels with rejectNews=true — the two local channels, which mix live threat posts with news about an attack that is already over. Such a post names the town and has threat words («Реактивним Шахедом», «влучання»), so without this it went out LOUD and started the town's cooldown, holding back the next real alert (2026-10-25). Matched on the normalized text, word-boundary anchored like threat-keywords.json.
_audit: Every word here must be impossible in a live threat post: a match drops the post outright, before the window. Check a new word against the shadow log first.
